name: Peet's Coffee
note: Peet's second store, after the original in Berkeley, opened in 1971 at the corner of Santa Cruz Avenue and University Drive. It briefly closed after a nearby fire in March 2009 and reopened that month.

name: Mountain Mike's

name: Kyosho
